newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil coffee council members now to meet July 22.
newsitem.headline: Brazil coffee council members now to meet July 22.

text.p: Members of Brazil's coffee council, known as the CDPC, will next meet in Brasilia on July 22, private sector officials said.
The members had been scheduled to hold talks July 15 but the meeting has been delayed for one week.
The council, which unites representatives from the public and private sectors, is to hold its next formal session in Santos but so far no date has been set.

Topics to be discussed by the council include credits for producers and how to help the domestic soluble coffee industry which claims to be losing competitiveness due to higher raw material costs than in other countries.
